items.caption: A modern redraw of 肉 in the Shuowen Small Seal tradition. Its enclosing outline and inner strokes illustrate a form associated with the pictograph for a piece of meat; this is not an excavated specimen.
items.alt: Black seal-script drawing of 肉, with an enclosing curved outline and two curved strokes inside.
items.selection_reason: This verified Small Seal redraw gives a useful visual example of the seal-script form and fits the sourced interpretation of 肉 as a meat pictograph. Its modern redraw status is clear.

limitations.text: The image is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact. The available evidence supports the pictographic interpretation and identifies script categories, but does not date this form or establish a detailed sequence of graphic changes.
